title: Billing Reference: The Claim Service Fee Amount on Harbison 5-Year and 10-Year Labor Protection
content:
**Clause.** The claim service fee charged on a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts is fixed for one service call: the service call on which a claim against that contract was decided on the date of handling. The date of that visit is the service call's completed date.

- The **visit fee** is the tier's claim service fee where at least one claim on the service call was approved or partially approved on its original decision, and zero otherwise.
- The **fee charged** is the visit fee, rounded to the cent, half up.

The tier's claim service fee is the figure listed for the tier in the Harbison Protection Contracts fee schedule.

**Condition, judgement, result.**

| Original decisions of the contract's claims on the service call | Visit fee | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| at least one approved | the tier's claim service fee | the visit fee, rounded to the cent |
| at least one partially approved, none approved | the tier's claim service fee | the visit fee, rounded to the cent |
| all denied | zero | $0.00 — no fee |

**Illustrations (hypothetical calls; the $80.00 fee figure is illustrative, not a schedule value).**

- A call with two claims against the contract, one approved and one denied, on a tier whose claim service fee is an illustrative $80.00: visit fee $80.00, fee charged **$80.00**.
- A call with one claim, partially approved: visit fee $80.00, fee charged **$80.00**.
- A call whose only claim was denied: visit fee zero; no fee is charged.
